## Checklist

- [ ] `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest assembleDebug` passes locally.
- [ ] New/changed behaviour has unit, integration, and/or E2E tests.
- [ ] No secrets, real IPs/hostnames, or `.jnlp` files added (use `192.0.2.x` and placeholders).
- [ ] Commit messages explain the change; this description says what and why.
- [ ] Linked to the relevant issue where one exists (e.g. `Closes #123`).
